segments.text:
V. 34.
Forthwith there came out blood and water—It was ſtrange, ſeeing He was dead, that Blood ſhould come out; more ſtrange that Water alſo; and moſt ſtrange of all, that both ſhould come out immediately, at one Time, and yet diſtinctly. It was pure and true Water, as well as pure and true Blood. The Aſſeveration of the Beholder and Teſtifier of it, ſhews both the Truth and Greatneſs of the Miracle and Myſtery.
